heading: Wednesday Night
text: Mostly clear. Areas of valley fog. Scattered frost away from Lake Champlain, except likely in northern cold hollows. Lows in the 30s to lower 40s, except low to mid 40s near Lake Champlain, and mid to upper 20s in northern cold hollows. Winds becoming light and variable.

heading: Thursday
text: Mostly sunny after any early fog. Highs from the mid 60s to around 70. North to northeast winds 5 to 10 mph.

heading: Thursday Night
text: Clear to partly cloudy. Lows from the upper 30s to mid 40s, except low to mid 30s in northern cold hollows. Winds diminishing to light and variable, remaining north 5 to 10 mph in the Champlain Valley.
